channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Video shows oil spill on Iranian island after refinery attack last month
item.description: The impact of an oil spill caused by an attack on Iran’s Lavan refinery last month has been revealed.

item.title: More than 15,800 people killed in Russia’s all-out war on Ukraine: UN
item.description: Nearly 800 children are among those killed in Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022, the UN says.

item.title: High prices in Iran’s stunted housing market leave tenants with few options
item.description: Tenants face bleak prospects as economic uncertainty persists amid a potential resumption of fighting.

item.title: Tributes pour in for ‘hero’ guard killed in San Diego mosque shooting
item.description: Amin Abdullah, the security guard killed while trying to stop gunmen entering the Islamic Centre of San Diego.

item.title: Trump says Xi assured him China would not send weapons to Iran
item.description: US president also says he could again strike Iran if progress on ceasefire is not made within 'days'.

item.title: Father-of-eight killed in San Diego mosque shooting hailed as hero
item.description: Security guard Amin Abdullah, one of three killed in the attack, was described as "a shining light".

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Four killed in protests during Kenyan strikes over high fuel prices
item.description: Thousands of commuters are stranded, with key roads in the capital Nairobi largely empty due to the protests over fuel costs.
